prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone landscape 16:9 cinematic exterior FRONT VIEW concept of 星契交易所, the AstralPact securities exchange, a magnificent PURPLE CRYSTAL PALACE in the coastal island capital Stardust. First candidate, not a diagram.
Reference roles in attachment order: Image 1 star-contract card is PRIMARY for visual identity: deep indigo-violet translucent faceted material, iridescent rainbow refraction, eight-point crystalline star, fine champagne-gold orbital engraving. Translate this identity into actual monumental architecture, not a giant upright card. Image 2 city establishes coastal bay setting, curved ivory-and-gold futuristic Eastern-inspired architecture, elegant arches and bridges, turquoise sea and mountain backdrop. Its giant upright ring landmark is separate; do not copy or replace it. Image 3 royal palace establishes high-end feature-film CGI quality, physically believable structure, flowing arches and refined gold tracery; do not copy its hillside palace layout or white dominant palette.
Main building: spectacular lavish purple amethyst crystal exchange palace, broad symmetric frontal facade, complete roof silhouette in frame, central lofty entrance hall, layered sweeping crystalline roof forms and tall violet faceted pylons with structurally legible champagne-gold ribs; rich transparent purple crystal walls with deep internal reflections, embedded cut gemstones sparkling at localized points, eight-point iridescent crystal star above main entrance and gold orbital motifs integrated into facade. Majority of palace reads PURPLE CRYSTAL, with restrained ivory structural accents. Prestigious civic financial institution, generous accessible entrance stairs and broad stone forecourt, convincing doors, floor levels and human-scale access. No text required.
USER ADDITION: At the entrance forecourt place ONE prominent bronze CHARGING BULL SCULPTURE in the spirit of the Wall Street bull: recognizable powerful muscular bull, lowered horned head, forward charging stance, four anatomically coherent legs planted on the paving, upward curling tail. It is a stationary bronze public sculpture, not a living animal. Place it slightly left of central axis in the near foreground so its full silhouette and horns are clear, photographed in three-quarter side view facing toward camera-right; it must be large enough to read yet must not obscure the palace main entrance. Warm bronze with polished rubbed highlights and darker patina, planted heavy hooves with contact shadows. No human statues or crowds.
Camera: frontal axial architectural establishing view from across the plaza, modest low viewpoint, approximately 28–35mm architectural lens, straight verticals, palace occupies most of width, full roof and both wings visible with air above, sculpture and entrance both clear. Same seaside world as reference city; glimpses of bay and elegant city structures at lateral edges, not a new arbitrary mountain citadel. Blue-hour sky with gentle remaining warm light, readable translucent violet architecture, inviting warm golden interior light. Extreme richness through craftsmanship and gemstone refraction, NOT blown-out neon outlines.
High-end feature-film 3D CGI, physically based materials, optical depth and subtle imperfections inside amethyst, crisp architectural joints, separate bronze/gold/stone/crystal responses, natural contact shadows, controlled jewel glints and restrained bloom, richly detailed but coherent and elegant. No gothic European church, no medieval castle, no casinos, no logos, no captions, no watermark, no collage, no smeared detail, no plastic toy finish.
